stem:
Mrs. Kelso and Mr. Bonham gave each of their students a small bag of colored tiles. The students each counted the number of purple tiles they received. The box plots display the data for both classes.

Which statement is best supported by the information in the box plots?

options.label: A
options.text: The range of the data for Mr. Bonham’s class is less than the range of the data for Mrs. Kelso’s class.

options.label: B
options.text: The data for Mrs. Kelso’s class are more symmetrical than the data for Mr. Bonham’s class.

options.label: C
options.text: The median number of the data for Mr. Bonham’s class is less than the median number of the data for Mrs. Kelso’s class.

options.label: D
options.text: The interquartile range of the data for Mrs. Kelso’s class is greater than the interquartile range of the data for Mr. Bonham’s class.

visual_elements: box plots showing number of purple tiles for Mrs. Kelso’s class and Mr. Bonham’s class with a number line from 5 to 20
